items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: we were doubling in a show 'Hello Daddy' with Lou Fields and we were playing at the hotel.

ctx.x: Not the stars, you know just the side men I think you call them. Well when you were making $650 as a top man for instance.

Well that was, we were doubling in a show 'Hello Daddy' with Lou Fields and we were playing at the hotel. That's what we made, that was our salary. Mine and Benny Goodman's and I believe Jack Teagarden's was the same. Because we were feature men. But that was a lot of money even in those days.

Gosh I don't think we were, as I recall I think we did a couple of recording dates in there for that also. But that was our average salary I would say was around $500 and then 50 bucks a date and we used to do two or three dates a week.
